senses.definition: present participle and gerund of scream
examples: For quotations using this term, see Citations:scream.

senses.definition: Loud, sharp, and piercing to the ear.

quotes.text: All undergraduate libraries have been a screaming success as study halls. The Undergraduate Library of the University of Michigan may be the smash hit of all time; the attendance in that library during 1968-69 was 1,899,000.

senses.definition: (informal) Hilariously funny; calculated to make people roar with laughter.
(gay slang) Effeminate, flamboyant or otherwise obviously gay.
examples: Did you see that guy at the bar? Screaming!

quotes.text: The hissings and screamings of the vulgar against him as he moved forward on his stedfast course he heeded less than those of geese on a common.
